english:
How long is the wait at the Biologist, the Stable Keeper (pony, Horse Books, medal trainings) and for the next skill book or Soul Stone? The Biologist and the Stable Keeper concern players; books and stones have separate waits for players and bots.
The level also sets the NPC exchange chances (Magic Dust / Parchment / Crafting Materials): easy 100/100/55%, medium 90/45/55%, hard 55/40/55%, custom - the M2_EXCHANGE_* numbers in .env.
A change needs a server restart (the web panel changes the same at once).

Ile czeka się u Biologa, u Stajennego (kucyk, Księgi Konia, treningi medalami) i na kolejną księgę umiejętności lub Kamień Duchowy? Biolog i Stajenny dotyczą graczy; księgi i Kamienie mają osobny czas dla graczy i dla botów.
Poziom ustawia też szanse wymiany u NPC (Magiczny Pył / Pergamin / Materiały rzemieślnicze): łatwy 100/100/55%, średni 90/45/55%, trudny 55/40/55%, własny - liczby M2_EXCHANGE_* w .env.
Zmiana wymaga restartu serwera (panel WWW zmienia to samo od razu).
translation:
생물학자, 마구간지기(포니, 말 책, 메달 훈련)에서, 그리고 다음 스킬북이나 영혼석까지 얼마나 기다려야 할까요? 생물학자와 마구간지기는 플레이어에게 해당하고, 책과 돌은 플레이어와 봇의 대기 시간이 따로 있습니다.
난이도는 NPC 교환 확률도 정합니다 (마법 가루 / 양피지 / 제작 재료): 쉬움 100/100/55%, 보통 90/45/55%, 어려움 55/40/55%, 사용자 지정 - .env의 M2_EXCHANGE_* 값.
변경하려면 서버를 재시작해야 합니다 (웹 패널은 같은 설정을 즉시 바꿉니다).

english: How fast the players' characters and the bots move, the Companion with them: a percent of the game's own speed, from 50 to 200. It goes on top of everything the game gives (gear, skills, potions, a sprint, a horse), on foot and in the saddle; the game shows at most 255, 2.55 times a character with nothing on (100), so a fast character gets there sooner. The bots move at the same pace as the players, and the Companion keeps up with its player; monsters move as in the game. The web panel changes it live without a restart.

Boty chodzą w tym samym tempie co gracze, a Towarzysz nadąża za swoim graczem; potwory poruszają się jak w grze. Panel WWW zmienia to na żywo bez restartu.
translation: 플레이어 캐릭터와 봇(동료 포함)이 얼마나 빨리 움직이는지: 게임 자체 속도의 퍼센트, 50에서 200까지. 게임이 주는 모든 것(장비, 스킬, 물약, 질주, 말) 위에 더해지며, 걸을 때도 말 탈 때도 적용됩니다; 게임은 최대 255, 아무것도 없는 캐릭터(100)의 2.55배까지만 보여 주므로 빠른 캐릭터는 더 일찍 거기에 닿습니다. 봇은 플레이어와 같은 속도로 움직이고, 동료는 자기 플레이어를 따라갑니다; 몬스터는 게임 그대로 움직입니다. 웹 패널은 재시작 없이 즉시 바꿉니다.

english: The game takes part of the drop chance from a character above its monster: two levels over 98% is left, five over 92%, ten over half (a boss and a Metin stone 30%), fifteen and more over 1%. This number is the least share of the chance a kill keeps whatever the level difference: 0 = the game's own penalty, 100 = no penalty, between = a floor. It never lowers a chance, so a character under its monster drops as before. Players and bots alike; yang and experience stay as they are. The web panel changes it live without a restart.
polski: Gra zabiera część szansy na drop postaci wyższej od potwora: 2 poziomy wyżej zostaje 98%, 5 wyżej 92%, 10 wyżej połowa (boss i Metin 30%), 15 i więcej wyżej 1%. english:
How many game channels the server runs. At the login
you choose a channel.

1 = one channel.
2 = a second channel (CH2): some of the bots play on it, and the server
spreads them over two processor cores. Shops (the bots' and the players')
stand on CH1 only: a bot on CH2 that wants to trade moves
to CH1 for a moment.
3 and 4 = and CH3 (and CH4) with fresh bots from level 1,
apart from the bots of CH1 and CH2. There are no shops, bot
guilds or wars there - the fresh bots sell to the merchant.

Every channel is about 2.5 GB of RAM. Opens ports 13000-13012
(2 channels), 13022 (3) or 13032 (4). A change works after
a server restart. Channels 3 and 4 are on the 2.x line only.

przechodzi na CH1.

osobnymi od botów z CH1 i CH2. Tam nie ma sklepów, gildii
botów ani wojen - świeże boty sprzedają u handlarza.

Każdy kanał to ok. 2,5 GB RAM. Otwiera porty 13000-13012
(2 kanały), 13022 (3) albo 13032 (4). Zmiana działa po
restarcie serwera. Kanały 3 i 4 są tylko na linii 2.x.

잠시 CH1으로 옮깁니다.
3과 4 = 레벨 1부터의 새 봇이 있는 CH3(과 CH4) 추가,
CH1과 CH2의 봇과는 별개입니다. 그곳에는 상점, 봇
길드, 전쟁이 없습니다 - 새 봇은 상인에게 팝니다.

서버 재시작 후 적용됩니다. 채널 3과 4는 2.x 계열에만 있습니다.

Wipe the world and start over?

The WHOLE current world goes: characters, levels, equipment, bots and game accounts. The launcher first saves it to a zip backup in the 'backups' folder, so you can go back to it with BACKUP / NEW WORLD -> Restore from a backup.

english:
Windows would not start the game client (metin2client.exe). Smart App Control did it: it blocks programs without a digital signature that Microsoft does not know, and the game client has no such signature.

It has no list of exceptions. The client starts only once it is off: Settings > Privacy & security > Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings > Off. Windows may not let you turn it back on without reinstalling the system, so decide for yourself.

Only take the client from the project's full package on Discord or from an update in the launcher.
polski:
Windows nie pozwolił uruchomić klienta gry (metin2client.exe). Zrobiła to Inteligentna kontrola aplikacji (Smart App Control): blokuje programy bez podpisu cyfrowego, których Microsoft nie zna, a klient gry takiego podpisu nie ma.

Ta funkcja nie ma listy wyjątków. Klient uruchomi się dopiero po jej wyłączeniu: Ustawienia > Prywatność i zabezpieczenia > Zabezpieczenia Windows > Kontrola aplikacji i przeglądarki > Ustawienia inteligentnej kontroli aplikacji > Wyłączone. Windows może potem nie pozwolić włączyć jej z powrotem bez ponownej instalacji systemu, więc zdecyduj sam.

Klienta bierz tylko z pełnej paczki z Discorda projektu albo z aktualizacji w launcherze.

예외 목록이 없습니다. 꺼야만 클라이언트가 시작됩니다: 설정 > 개인 정보 및 보안 > Windows 보안 > 앱 및 브라우저 컨트롤 > 스마트 앱 컨트롤 설정 > 끄기. 시스템을 다시 설치하지 않으면 Windows가 다시 켜지 못하게 할 수도 있으니 직접 판단하세요.

english:
An antivirus blocked the game client (metin2client.exe). Windows Defender can take it for a threat (e.g. Trojan:Script/Wacatac). It is a false alarm: the file has no digital signature, so a heuristic judges it.

What to do: Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection history > the entry for metin2client.exe > Actions > Restore. Then exclude the client folder: Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions > Add an exclusion > Folder.

Only make that exception for the client from the project's full package on Discord or from an update in the launcher.
polski:
Program antywirusowy zablokował klienta gry (metin2client.exe). Windows Defender potrafi uznać go za zagrożenie (np. Trojan:Script/Wacatac). To fałszywy alarm: plik nie ma podpisu cyfrowego, więc ocenia go heurystyka.

Co zrobić: Zabezpieczenia Windows > Ochrona przed wirusami i zagrożeniami > Historia ochrony > wpis z metin2client.exe > Akcje > Przywróć. Potem dodaj folder klienta do wykluczeń: Ochrona przed wirusami i zagrożeniami > Zarządzaj ustawieniami > Wykluczenia > Dodaj wykluczenie > Folder.

Wyjątek dodawaj tylko dla klienta z pełnej paczki z Discorda projektu albo z aktualizacji w launcherze.
translation:
백신이 게임 클라이언트(metin2client.exe)를 차단했습니다. Windows Defender가 위협으로 볼 수 있습니다 (예: Trojan:Script/Wacatac). 오탐입니다: 파일에 디지털 서명이 없어 휴리스틱이 판단합니다.

해결 방법: Windows 보안 > 바이러스 및 위협 방지 > 보호 기록 > metin2client.exe 항목 > 작업 > 복원. 그다음 클라이언트 폴더를 제외하세요: 바이러스 및 위협 방지 > 설정 관리 > 제외 > 제외 추가 > 폴더.
